$comment: Per-channel video specs, the data `vos deliver` loops over (mirrored as references/channel-specs.md in vosjs/skills; update together). Verified against official platform docs 2026-08-04; platform specs drift, re-verify quarterly. `text` is the destination word policy: 'none' (the picture carries it alone, so the beat captions drop), 'allowed', 'expected'.

specs.notes: Captions burned in. The same public upload serves the Chrome Web Store promo video and Product Hunt video (both take YouTube URLs only).
30–60s plays best; 140s/512MB is the free-tier ceiling. 1:1 also allowed. Native upload, never a link post.
Critical text inside a centered ~900×1160 safe zone — platform chrome covers the rest. Serves YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn native vertical.
≤10MB is the free-plan attachment ceiling; two-pass target bitrate from duration.
